summary.en: A contributory pension scheme with enrollment conditions and contribution amounts defined by official rules.
summary.te: అధికారిక నియమాల ప్రకారం చందాలతో నడిచే పెన్షన్ పథకం.
summary.hi: आधिकारिक नियमों के अनुसार अंशदान आधारित पेंशन योजना।

benefits: Pension benefits subject to age, contribution, and scheme conditions.
required_documents: Savings bank or post office account details for official enrollment
how_to_apply: Ask a participating bank or post office for current eligibility and contribution details.
helpline: Contact the participating bank or PFRDA through its official site.
